name: check_room
description: Checks whether a room is available for a requested time slot. This tool only checks availability and does not save or create a booking. All time values must be whole minutes since midnight in the range 0-1440 (for example, 600 is 10:00 and 1440 is 24:00).

start.description: Requested booking start time in whole minutes since midnight (0-1440).

end.description: Requested booking end time in whole minutes since midnight (0-1440).

now.description: Current time in whole minutes since midnight (0-1440).

blocked.description: Whether the room is currently blocked (true or false).

bookings.description: List of existing bookings for the room, each with start and end in minutes since midnight (0-1440). May be empty.

start.description: Existing booking start time in whole minutes since midnight (0-1440).

end.description: Existing booking end time in whole minutes since midnight (0-1440).
